data.one_liner: Provides common string manipulation and validation extension methods.
data.what_it_does: Extends the Dart String class with utilities like case checking, casing transformations, character indexing, word wrapping, and substring containment checks inspired by other programming languages.
use_when: You need helper methods for string validation like isAlpha or isInteger.
You want convenient methods for capitalizing, swapping case, or converting strings to camelCase and title case.
You need to perform word wrapping or check if a string contains all or any items from a list.
avoid_when: You only require standard Dart core string operations.
You need complex localization or internationalization parsing.
strengths: Adds a comprehensive collection of missing utility methods to the core String class.
Simple API with straightforward extension methods.
weaknesses: Limited to string operations and lacks advanced text processing or templating features.
No built-in localization awareness for string transformations.
